annotations.title: Project year-end tax for an employee

description: Use this when someone paid by paycheck asks how much federal tax they will owe this year, whether they will get a refund, or whether to change their withholding before the year ends. From the latest paystub it projects full-year wages, federal tax, the balance or refund, the underpayment safe harbor, and the extra withholding per remaining paycheck that reaches it. Wages only.

age_65_or_over.description: The taxpayer is 65 or older at the end of the year.

expected_bonus_usd.description: A bonus still expected this year that is not yet on the paystub.

filing_status.description: Federal filing status for the year.

other_dependents.description: Dependents who are not qualifying children.

paychecks_received.description: Number of paychecks received so far this year.

paychecks_remaining.description: Number of paychecks still to come this year. Zero when the last paycheck of the year has been paid.

prior_year_agi_usd.description: Adjusted gross income on last year's return (2025 Form 1040, line 11b).

prior_year_total_tax_usd.description: Total tax on last year's return (2025 Form 1040, line 24). Enables the safe harbor based on last year.

qualifying_children.description: Children under 17 claimed for the child tax credit.

spouse_age_65_or_over.description: Married filing jointly only: the spouse is 65 or older at the end of the year.

spouse_paychecks_received.description: Married filing jointly only: paychecks the spouse has received so far this year.

spouse_paychecks_remaining.description: Married filing jointly only: paychecks the spouse still has to come this year.

spouse_ytd_federal_withholding_usd.description: Married filing jointly only: the spouse's year-to-date federal income tax withheld.

spouse_ytd_wages_usd.description: Married filing jointly only: the spouse's year-to-date federal taxable wages.

ytd_federal_withholding_usd.description: Year-to-date federal income tax withheld from the same paystub. Not Social Security or Medicare.

ytd_wages_usd.description: Year-to-date federal taxable wages from the latest paystub (not gross pay). If you already have a full-year figure, pass it here with paychecks_remaining 0.

name: project_year_end_tax

next_step.description: A single review link appropriate to this server surface.

relay.description: Instruction to the calling assistant: relay figures and dates verbatim (identical on every response).

server_version.description: Server release that produced this response (matches GET /version).

source_url.description: The arcandledger.com page that backs this answer.
